title: Euro 2012 Semifinals: Italy 2, Germany 1 - The New York Times
content: ###### Goal | Euro 2012 Semifinals: Italy 2, Germany 1. # Euro 2012 Semifinals: Italy 2, Germany 1. *Duncan Irving of The Goal blog provided live coverage of today’s Euro 2012 semifinal game between Germany and Italy. Two first-half goals by striker Mario Balotelli inspired Italy to an upset 2-1 win over Germany in Warsaw on Thursday night. Italy took the lead in the 20th minute when Balotelli rose above Holger Badstuber to head Antonio Cassano’s cross into the German net. German coach Joachim Loew made a number of changes at halftime, but the Germans were unable to force a goal until stoppage time, when Mesut Ozil scored from the penalty spot after a Federico Balzaretti handball. Italy will face Spain in the final on Sunday in Kiev, two weeks to the day that after the two teams played out a 1-1 tie in their Group C opener. Italy moves on to the final in Kiev. ##### 92nd minute **GOAL Italy 2-1 Germany**.
